signature.name: VTask.restrictScalars
signature.type: {A : Type u_1} -> {M₁ : Type u_2} -> {M₂ : Type u_3} -> (R : Type u_4) -> [Semiring A] -> [Semiring R] -> [AddCommMonoid M₁] -> [Module A M₁] -> [Module R M₁] -> [TopologicalSpace M₁] -> [AddCommMonoid M₂] -> [Module A M₂] -> [Module R M₂] -> [TopologicalSpace M₂] -> [LinearMap.CompatibleSMul M₁ M₂ R A] -> (f : M₁ →L[A] M₂) -> M₁ →L[R] M₂

conventions.statement: The underlying set-function of `VTask.restrictScalars R f` is definitionally equal to that of `f`; only the linearity and continuity witnesses are repackaged, no new function is built.
conventions.note: This is a standard junk-value convention: coercing to a function gives the same result regardless of which scalar ring is named.
